name: CalibRaw
tagline: Develop RAW photos with non-destructive editing
blurb: CalibRaw is a GPU-accelerated RAW photo editor.
description:
CalibRaw is a GPU-accelerated RAW photo editor. Browse your photo library,
develop camera RAW files, and fine-tune color, tone, and detail in one
workflow. Adjustments are saved in sidecar files so your original photos
remain intact.

Shape your images with tone curves, color wheels, and targeted color
adjustments. Apply lens corrections, recover highlights, and combine
bracketed exposures with HDR merge. Brush, gradient, and shape masks let
you make local adjustments, while optional AI tools process masks, noise
reduction, and object removal on your device after downloading their
models.

• Develop RAW files from a wide range of cameras, including Fujifilm X-Trans sensors

• Adjust exposure, white balance, tone curves, and individual color ranges

• Correct lens distortion, chromatic aberration, and vignetting

• Apply local masks and creative effects with independent adjustments

• Export finished photos, including lossless JPEG XL images

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
